question: Which of the following is the best-known metabolic function of the lung

options.opd: Metabolism of basic drugs by cytochrome P–450 system

analysis: The lungs play a crucial role in the conversion of angiotensin-I to angiotensin-II through the action of angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) located in the pulmonary endothelium. This function is significant in the regulation of blood pressure and fluid balance. While the lungs also inactivate serotonin and bradykinin, the conversion of angiotensin-I to angiotensin-II is the most well-known metabolic function associated with the lungs.
